userStories.title: praxis week and its flags
acceptanceCriteria: `praxis week`, `--week <iso>`, `--dry-run`, `--frontier-only`, `--explain-judging`, `--notify`, and `--write-html` are wired to the orchestrator with documented behavior
`--week` accepts ISO-week strings like 2026-W21 and renders a past week's data

userStories.title: Auxiliary commands present
acceptanceCriteria: `praxis re-score <session_stable_id>` re-runs the frontier judge for that session and updates session_scores
`praxis baseline`, `praxis follow-up`, `praxis history`, `praxis show <week_iso>` are wired to read-only operations and exit 0
`praxis scan` performs scan + score without rendering a digest
`praxis status`, `praxis rubric`, `praxis models` are preserved from v0.1

userStories.title: Exit code 2 when no API key is configured
acceptanceCriteria: When neither Anthropic nor OpenAI credentials are available, the CLI exits with code 2 and prints a clear message naming both env vars

userStories.title: Exit code 3 when no sessions in the window
acceptanceCriteria: If the scan returns zero in-window sessions, the CLI exits with code 3 and prints a clear message

userStories.title: Removed commands and flags are gone
acceptanceCriteria: `praxis install-daemon` (the v0.1 daily one) is absent
The v0.1 daily orchestrator entry point is not registered as a subcommand
